brief: Sales kick-off in or near Munich for 120 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-01-20. We need a plenary room plus 4 breakout rooms for the regional sessions. Budget EUR 70,000 all in.

input.query: sales kick-off conference hotel plenary breakout rooms

input.summary: Three Munich-area venues are open on 2027-01-20 and all quote under the EUR 70,000 budget. Each needs budget-owner sign-off because it is over EUR 20,000. Alte Maelzerei is the cheapest, and Isarforum has the most room to grow.

offers.tradeOff: Lowest price and 5 breakouts, but the 150-seat hall and 120 rooms leave no headroom for extra guests.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Purpose-built for kick-offs with 250-seat plenary, 8 breakouts and spare rooms, for about EUR 2,760 more than Maelzerei.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Mountain-view setting in Tegernheim, but the highest price, the longest train ride (5 h) and exactly 4 breakouts.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: RFP: Sales kick-off, 120 guests, arrival 2027-01-20 (1 night)
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a sales kick-off and would like a proposal.

Arrival: 2027-01-20, 1 night (departure 2027-01-21)
Guests: 120
Room nights: 120 single-occupancy rooms for 1 night
Meeting space: 1 plenary room for 120 people plus 4 breakout rooms for regional sessions
Catering: day delegate package with lunch and coffee
Dietary needs: none reported so far; please confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options
Accessibility: no wheelchair users at present; step-free access preferred
Budget: up to EUR 70,000 all in

Please send an itemised offer, including room, meeting, breakout and catering costs, and confirm availability.

Please reply by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
